name: Chouchou Jiken Lovesodic
original_name: 蝶々事件ラブソディック
source:
Everybody, this girl is my younger sister. Please get along with her.
I'm sorry. Because… she has a very nice scent.

"Hey, you have a really sweet smell.
Fufu, when I touch you, that sweet smell gets stronger."

The 5th year of the Shouwa era (1930)…
A girl descends into the blossoming Yokohama, a cosmopolitan town brimming with an exotic atmosphere.

An aesthetic mystery delivered to you by 3 companies: Aria (Kodansha), Red Entertainment and Otomate.

Your scent will drive them wild.

That look on your face… Maybe you've met "those guys" already?

Bad things will definitely happen.

[Translation of the text in its [URL=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GCLm3CSM5O0]Otomate Party 2016 trailer[/URL].]
translation:
大家好，这个女孩是我的妹妹。请和她好好相处。
对不起。因为……她有一种非常好闻的气味。

“嘿嘿，你的味道真香。
呼呼，一碰你，那股甜香就更浓了。”

昭和5年（1930年）…
一个女孩来到了繁华的横滨，这是一个充满异国情调的国际化小镇。

由3家公司为你呈现的美学之谜：Aria（讲谈社）、Red Entertainment和Otomate。

你的气味会让它们疯狂。

你脸上的表情……也许你已经见过“那些家伙”了？

肯定会发生不好的事情。

[[URL=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GCLm3CSM5O0]Otomate Party 2016预告片[/URL]中文本的翻译。]
